purpose: Known public historical research inventory and bounded next research queue; no private account or forward portfolio data.
return_units: Historical returns and drawdowns are fractions unless a field explicitly says percent. Periods start independently and must not be concatenated.
live_promotion: Forbidden automatically. Every strategy remains unapproved for real-money deployment pending explicit separate approval and the research plan gates.
trial_inventory_status: Known studies consolidated from archived reports; historical trial completeness is not established. Scenario counts include correlated candidates, periods and costs, not independent discoveries.

stock_retrospective_validation.note: Selected after later development, then evaluated on earlier data; not prospective. August 2025 excluded because already used for warm-up.

stock_extended_segments.note: Independent complete-data intervals, each reset for research. Do not stitch. Market-filter consistency study moves the first segment start to 2016-11-01 for common warm-up. Gap exclusion can bias results.

stock_reserved_incomplete.note: Archive reached partial May 2023. No complete stock intraday confirmation reported; related daily asset periods have been inspected in other studies, so this is not pristine global holdout data.

etf_comparison.note: Originally reserved for the selected three-ETF rule; later reused by cross-asset research. Cannot be called untouched again.

trading_research_v01.contents: Source bars/calendar/actions, baseline and phase2/phase3 engines, protocols, tests, trade/mark/daily CSVs and historical results.

long_history.contents: Raw 2016-2022 stock bars and partial 2023, complete-data segment manifests, actions and re-queries, three-ETF daily history, tests and research outputs.

cross_asset.contents: 2016-01-04 to 2026-09-09 daily ETF history (2686 sessions per asset), crypto 2021-01-01 to 2026-09-09 (2078 days per coin), actions, protocol, engine and 81 scenario results.

crypto_replay.note: Imports the crypto rule implementation; a daily-open proxy, not exact historical decision-window execution or a fresh holdout.

hedged_futures.contents: Scenario arithmetic, six accounting tests and cached crypto spot data; no historical futures contract backtest.

studies.scenario_count_note: 63 ETF and 18 crypto runs, including references, periods and cost assumptions.

known_data_issues: Modern fixed stock watchlist has selection/survivorship bias; no reconstructed delisted universe.
2016-2022 stock intraday gaps produced segmented studies; difficult missing dates cannot be treated as zero-return days.
Complete2023-2024 stock intraday dataset unavailable in archived study.
Missing June2018 SPY distribution can affect early2019 cross-asset lookbacks.
34 cross-asset dividend payment dates missing since2019; receivables not spendable and values not all independently verified.
Historical execution uses bar proxies and fixed costs; prospective failures/latency need separate modeling.
Prior Sharpe values use different risk-free conventions; normalization required before ranking.
new_work_claim: This registry documents prior evidence and planned gates. It does not claim new backtests, successful repairs, deployments, or live authorization.
